resources.name: stdlib-packages-json
resources.title: Standard Library Package Catalog
resources.description: A mapping between standard library package names and catalog metadata.

resources.name: stdlib-packages-contributor-json
resources.title: Contributor-facing Package Catalog (JSON)
resources.description: Array of package records with stripped `@stdlib/` prefix; primary fields are `name` and `description`, followed by capability metadata. Maintained at docs/contributing/packages.json for contributor and agent consumption.

resources.name: stdlib-packages-contributor-csv
resources.title: Contributor-facing Package Catalog (CSV)
resources.description: Token-efficient package catalog with stripped `@stdlib/` prefix; primary columns are `name` and `description`, followed by `alias`, `type`, capability flags, and a semicolon-separated `related` column. Maintained at docs/contributing/packages.csv for contributor and agent consumption.
